verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents an 'Offline support' feature. Its help text implies offline state reconciles once you are back online: snoozed messages reappear only after reconnecting. A community user confirms that 'Offline mode finally arrived.' The evidence does not show which parts of the story work offline. missing for 10: documented offline reading scope, offline search, offline composing/sending with queued delivery, explicit sync-on-reconnect behavior for user changes, independent hands-on corroboration of these behaviors.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect

citations.quote: If you're offline when a snoozed message is scheduled to return to your Inbox, you will not see the snoozed message reappear until you're back online.
